title: Considerations of Inter-Ministerial Committee to Review Singapore’s Anti-money Laundering Legislation Regime
what_it_is: Considerations of Inter-Ministerial Committee to Review Singapore’s Anti-money Laundering Legislation Regime

sections.label: IMC anti-money laundering review
sections.summary: The IMC will consider how criminals exploit systems and recommend keeping the anti-money laundering regime effective, reporting findings in the fourth quarter; MHA reviewed penalties in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) review, the IMC will indeed consider the increasingly sophisticated ways by which criminals may seek to exploit our systems and make recommendations to ensure that our anti-money laundering regime remains effective in preventing, detecting and enforcing against such.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The IMC will share its full findings and recommendations in the fourth quarter of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As for the adequacy of the penalties prescribed in the law, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) regularly reviews such, the last time being just recently in 2023.

sections.label: Whole-of-Government monitoring cybercrime
sections.summary: A whole-of-Government approach is being taken to strengthen monitoring and sense-making capabilities, including looking into areas of cybercrime.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Earlier in my response, I had mentioned that we are taking a whole-of-Government approach to strengthen our monitoring and sense-making capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This would include looking into areas of cybercrime.

sections.label: IMC guarding corporate structures
sections.summary: The IMC is working to ensure corporate structures in Singapore are not abused by money launderers, alongside gatekeepers like real estate agents, lawyers, dealers and corporate service providers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Indeed, the IMC is undertaking rigorous work to ensure that corporate structures in Singapore are not being abused by money launderers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I also earlier mentioned other gatekeepers in the system, such as real estate agents, lawyers, precious stones and metals' dealers and corporate service providers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: All these actions would help us better guard against potential money launderers trying to launder their monies through Singapore's ecosystem.
